title: Sigmoid function
tagline: Squashes any real number into (0, 1) — a smooth on/off switch.
history: The logistic function goes back to Verhulst (1838); it became the classic activation that let neural networks learn non-linear functions.
useCases: Turning a score into a 0–1 confidence
whenToUse: When you need a bounded (0, 1) output — a probability or a soft gate.
whenNotToUse: Deep hidden layers: gradients vanish. Prefer ReLU/GELU there, and softmax for multi-class output.
complexity: O(1) per element · derivative is σ(z)·(1 − σ(z))
